name: web-intel-mcp
description: Páginas web a Markdown limpio, metadatos, enlaces, stack técnico y auditorías SEO. Pago por uso con créditos KeyFlint.
long_description: Lee cualquier URL y devuelve Markdown limpio, metadatos (Open Graph, JSON-LD), enlaces, stack tecnológico y una auditoría SEO puntuada. Cada llamada descuenta créditos de tu licencia KeyFlint; las herramientas pricing y credits_balance son gratis.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (nav, ads and cookie banners removed).

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Title, description, canonical, lang, robots, Open Graph, JSON-LD types, H1-H3 and image alt stats.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Internal and external links on a page (deduplicated, absolute URLs, anchor text).

tools.name: tech_stack
tools.description: Detect frameworks, CMS, analytics, payments, CDN/hosting and security headers of a site.

tools.name: seo_audit
tools.description: Scored on-page SEO audit (0-100, A-F) with 16 weighted checks and the top fixes to apply first.

tools.name: compare_seo
tools.description: Audit 2-5 pages (e.g. you vs competitors) and rank them. Costs seo_audit price x number of URLs.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Credit price of each tool and where to buy credits. Free.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: Remaining credits on your KeyFlint license. Free.

license_key.title: Licencia KeyFlint
license_key.description: Tu licencia (empieza por LIC-). La recibes al comprar en mcp.keyflint.dev; una sola licencia sirve para todos los MCPs.
